summary: Deployment acceptance on five representative paths, run on the switched runtime by companion-deploy.sh (after runtime sync) and activate-ui-playbooks.sh (after the switch): owner brain agenda read, test contact « Recette Pulse » project list, incomplete creation that must ask, owner agenda write that must stop at the recap (then cancelled), app reads. A failed path rolls back (switches back for playbooks); a provider outage is inconclusive. The section is written to the deploy receipt. The first S24 run found a real defect, fixed here: an out-of-hours creation in the Pulse room rendered « n'a pas abouti » instead of the canonical closed-hours sentence.
reason: Amine 29/10: deploy-time acceptance only, five representative paths, failure blocks activation; test contact « Recette Pulse » (fictitious +216 10 000 001) added with his biometrics.

limitations: Adds about 1-2 minutes to a deploy (owner brain turns).
The owner paths use a dedicated session agent:main:recette-deploy; a pending recap there is cancelled at the end of each run.
At night the room paths only reach the closed-hours answer, which counts as a pass.
